subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: Should this issue remain the broad owner for a shared Gateway partial-reload/readiness contract covering `sessions.resolve`, Control UI degraded state, launchd restart recovery, and stale-process handoff, or should maintainers narrow it to the WebChat no-notice subset handled by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95141 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154?
rationale: The source evidence supports a real gap, but the final contract changes user-visible readiness semantics across Gateway RPCs, Control UI UX, restart recovery, and managed macOS service behavior, which is a product boundary rather than a mechanical one-file bug fix.

options.title: Keep Broad Readiness Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned design that unifies partial-reload readiness, `sessions.resolve`, Control UI degraded UI, launchd restart recovery, and live proof.

options.title: Narrow To WebChat Notice
options.body: Treat the remaining work as the narrower WebChat unresumable-notice path and close or supersede this issue only after maintainers accept that narrower scope.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Pause implementation until a fresh macOS launchd replay confirms which current-main failure modes still reproduce beyond the saved incident logs.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Readiness Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned design that unifies partial-reload readiness, `sessions.resolve`, Control UI degraded UI, launchd restart recovery, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history covers gateway restart deferral and reload ownership, and the remaining question is a cross-surface Gateway readiness/recovery product contract.
